newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech 1997 farm subsidies to rise 20 pct - AgMin.
newsitem.headline: Czech 1997 farm subsidies to rise 20 pct - AgMin.

text.p: The Czech Agricuture Ministry wil pay out a total of 8.01 billion crowns in subsidies to farmers this year, up 20 percent from 1996, Agriculture Minister Josef Lux said on Friday.

Speaking at a news conference, Lux said that 500 million crowns of the total would be used for indirect support of exports of selected commodities. He addded that 53 percent of the sum would come in direct subsidies, while a state support and guarantee fund would recieve the rest.
Exports will be supported through subsidising interest on export-related credits, Lux said.
"I think it will be possible to support commodities like hops, malt, poultry, fruits and fruit juices," he said.
The minister told reporters that farmers in mountainous areas would recieve the total of 2.3 billion in land maintenance and beef cattle subsidies. --Jan Lopatka, Prague Newsroom, 42-2-2243-0003
